column1: # coloma1622 key C04, CC BY 4.0 (Brice Dudout, Europe chiffrée, 2026). Syllabary on a grid with numbers and underlined code
# words, rebuilt from the contemporary margin clears of the Duke of Feria's letters to Coloma (BNE RES/227/120, 127, 128, 129)
# and from Mirabel f.1r-f.1v. Frozen by SHA-256 before its last test (714f70ba...). UPPER CASE = code word (whole word);
# empty = null. Not in the key (unknown): 4‡, q̲, x̤, and the codes 141, 48, 39, 295, 2, 127, 40, 264, 52, L/54/y.
# Integration note, 12 Nov 2026 (PR #417). The rows below are the frozen key C04, left unchanged so that decryption.txt stays its
# mechanical output. The reading of 11 Nov 2026 (reading.md) departs from them at these tokens:
#   _30_  key TERMI            reading ALLA (allanar, allanado; sense and alphabetical order, two places)
#   _35_  key CORRESPONDENCIA  reading AMISTAD (sense and alphabetical order, one place, restored)
#   bo    key la               reading: no value (held by no clear, one place), unresolved
#   +     key (null)           reading: i after que ("aqui"; the contributor cites the clear of a Feria letter)
#   sa    key a                reading: al ("igual"; the contributor cites the clear of RES/227/128, 4 places)
#   141   not in the key       reading ELLO (contemporary clear of BNE MSS/18428 fol. 31)
# 318 OFICIO (a row below) is now held by the same clear. Values the reading proposes by sense and order, in no key or clear:
# 48 TRATA, _52_ CRISTIAN, 127 DIFICULTAD, _40_ BAJO, 264 HONRA, 295 MANDA, _54_ CATOLICA in the group L/54/y. Still unknown: 39, 2.
# Integration note, 13 Nov 2026 (PR #543). Rows still unchanged. From contemporary clears of BNE MSS/18428 the reading now also takes
#   _39_ BIEN, 4‡ g (not rows here); 308 is NUESTRO in the clears (nuestros enemigos, nuestras armas), with 34ʳ SR for señor (the
#   row below says NUESTRO SEÑOR); 60 i, sa al, + i after que are confirmed by the margin clears of v5 d - v7 d. Unknown now: 2.
# The SHA-256 714f70ba... above is not that of this file (3a608469...); it is probably that of the contributor's working copy.
